landing.subtitle: Help keep our streets safe in Kanpur, Varanasi, and across UP. Snap a photo of the problem — we'll figure out what it is and send it to the right department.
landing.step1_desc: Take a quick photo of the pothole or broken light.
landing.step2_desc: Confirm the exact street location on the map.
landing.step3_desc: Our system identifies the issue and routes it directly to the local ward officer.
landing.step4_desc: Get updates right here until the job is done.

report.title: Report an Issue
report.subtitle: Upload a photo of a public issue. Our system will analyze it, extract details, and route it instantly.
report.upload_placeholder: Upload a photo and analyze it to see extracted details here.
report.pin_instruction: Click anywhere on the map to place the pin precisely.
